clips.english: This became a common practice, but iron became more common in wooden car wheels.
clips.english_reference: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.

clips.english: Arabs also brought Islam to the island and worked extensively in the Comoros and Mayotte.
clips.english_reference: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
